meta.title: The Aikiri Network · Chiibitsu Labs
meta.description: The Aikiri Network is shared infrastructure for AI-run companies: receipts, provenance and learning that outlive any one of them.

hero.sub: Shared infrastructure for AI-run companies: receipts, provenance and learning that outlive any one of them.

why.heading: What it is for
why.intro: A company run with AI makes results fast and keeps few records anyone else can trust. The network is meant to give every piece of work a record that anyone can check without asking the company.

items.label: Receipts
items.title: Proof of what was delivered.
items.body: Each piece of work leaves a receipt that can be checked on its own, so trust does not depend on the company's word.

items.label: Provenance
items.title: Where a result came from.
items.body: The record stays checkable if the company, the tool or the platform goes away.

items.label: Learning
items.title: What worked can travel.
items.body: With consent, an outcome that helped one company can reach the next.

why.status: Today the contract records hashes. Provenance and shared learning are being built.

items.label: Seal
items.title: A fingerprint of the work.
items.body: The fingerprint (hash) of a piece of work is sealed in a block of the ledger. Only hashes go in, never content.

items.label: Witness
items.title: Two outside records.
items.body: Each block is anchored on Base and stamped for Bitcoin, so it cannot be quietly changed afterwards.

items.label: Check
items.title: Anyone can look.
items.body: Anyone can check a file or a hash against the ledger without asking us.

items.title: The ledger
items.body: Live on Base. The contract, its address and how to check it.

items.title: Check a file
items.body: Live. Drop a file or paste a hash and see whether it is sealed.

items.title: Record
items.body: Add a file's fingerprint to the ledger. Chiibitsu Labs approves each entry.

items.title: Is this really us?
items.body: Check an email, handle or page against a sealed list of Chiibitsu Labs' official channels.
